method: English word(s) taken from each English Wiktionary gloss (form-of senses and wikitext glosses skipped; parentheticals removed; split on ';' and ','; leading to/a/an/the removed; 1-3 words kept). Each English word is looked up in English Wiktionary for French and Spanish translation-table entries, and in French and Spanish Wiktionary for their glosses of the English word. Items whose English POS matches the source sense POS are preferred; otherwise all are kept with pos_match=false. No equivalent is selected or approved.
